dedupe_keys.name: asnr incident notices for french nuclear installations significant events rated on the ines scale with rss feeds

description: The French nuclear safety and radiation protection authority, ASNR, publishes notices of significant events, meaning incidents and accidents classified on the INES scale, in French basic nuclear installations and in the transport of radioactive substances, and systematically publishes events rated level 1 and above. On the day of cataloguing the list held 3,149 notices over 210 pages, the newest dated 23 September 2026, covering EDF power reactors such as Civaux and Tricastin, research reactors such as the ILL high-flux reactor, and fuel cycle and laboratory sites of Framatome and the CEA; each notice names the site, operator, date of declaration and a description of the event and its causes. The authority also offers RSS feeds, listed on data.gouv.fr under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 and updated on 25 September 2026, and a PDF of the INES scale. Access is free online. Coverage is France. Caveats: notices are narrative web pages without a bulk table, so building a series means collecting pages or feeds, and INES ratings can be revised. Simulation uses are nuclear plant event frequencies and failure modes, such as loss of backup power or instrumentation, for reliability and cascading risk studies. Related records: data-nrc-datasets-us-nuclear-facilities covers US nuclear facilities.
